title: The large-coefficient QC control and smaller ROC control are distinct
statement: Source qc_extension.py reconstructs H_(8/7)=|S|^4-(16/7)|S|^2detS Hessian-QC via exact closed quadratic two-form/primitive and all 12x12 positive Gram coefficients,with Gram-2^-16I positive definite over Q. H_(11/10)=(77/80)H_(8/7)+(3/80)|S|^4 has strong actual QC modulus3/320. With C=1024,nu=1,mu=2^192 meets full QC bound,so P_QC(A)=H_(11/10)(symA)+(b-c)^2+2^192|A|^6 is globally QC/ROC and NON-POLYCONVEX. At t=2^-110,P_QC(tI)<0; determinant support at0 forced to vanish by both determinant signs in quadratic kernel Sym(2),so non-PC does not imply QC failure. Earlier coefficient 2^32 control is globally ROC/non-PC with QC UNKNOWN; large-mu result does not certify it. Supplied exact rational replay reports coefficients/positive matrices/standalone certificate; Capital did not execute it and no independent audit is inferred.
